layers.text: Subject: the wooden deck of a ship seen from straight above, the planks running off every edge of the picture with no frame, no rim and no plate. Long straight narrow planks lying left to right, all the same width, about twenty planks from the top of the picture to the bottom, warm honey-brown wood #9c6c40 separated by thin dark brown #5e3c20 seams, the plank ends butted at staggered places with two tiny dark nail heads at each end, soft fine wood grain in slightly darker #86592f and lighter #b07e4c, a few planks a little lighter or darker than the others. Evenly lit, low contrast, calm. Painterly 16-bit strategy-game battle ground.
